claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026
Artemis II is scheduled to launch at 6:24 p.m. EDT (22:24 UTC)
The Artemis II launch opens a two-hour window until 8:24 p.m. EDT
Artemis II is scheduled to launch from Launch Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida
Artemis II marks the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft to orbit the Moon
Live all-day coverage of Artemis II is available on NASA's YouTube channel beginning at 7:45 a.m. EDT
Current forecasts show an 80% chance of favorable weather for the Artemis II launch

Backup opportunities are available if a delay occurs for the Artemis II launch
